subject: Hosted API commit uplift — elastic ladder proposal & billing corridor
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@edgecart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Mike Hall <mike.hall@edgecart.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API capacity — looking to lock in uplift this quarter

Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're seeing a sustained +65% token growth month-over-month on the checkout personalization calls and Q3 forecast is showing another step-up. Procurement asked me to get a formal proposal for a hosted commit uplift we can bring to execs next Tuesday.

Current ask:
- Increase hosted monthly commit from 10M tokens to 25M tokens
- Add a 10M/month burst pocket for seasonal traffic
- Keep soft-throttle at 95th percentile latency <= 250ms
- 12-month term, with an option to renegotiate after 6 months based on usage

Attached: edgecart-q3-usage.csv (monthly token breakdown)

Can you send a proposed tier and pricing band + a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can share with legal/procurement? Also looping in Mike (procurement) to coordinate PO timing.

Sara Li
Head of ML Product
EdgeCart
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com (Jonas Weber)
To: Sara Li <sara@edgecart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-18T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity — looking to lock in uplift this quarter

Sara — thanks for the context and the usage file.

High level plan I propose:
1) Elastic commit ladder: 10M -> 25M committed tokens/month baseline, with automated step-ups at 3 and 6 months if utilization exceeds 85% of committed baseline for two consecutive months. This preserves predictability while allowing growth.
2) Burst pocket: provision a 10M/month buffer that resets monthly; unused burst does not roll over.
3) Rateband & latency: we'll map a soft-throttle window and commit a rule that routes >95th pct traffic to a slightly lower-cost variant to hold latency SLOs during spikes (we can surface route-level tracing in Console).
4) Commercial: 12-month term, prorated activation on signing; propose a 15% unit discount on hosted tokens for the uplift band and a separate burst rate.

I'll attach a one-page MAP and a draft pricing schedule for your review. Can we lock a brief call Friday to run through legal/PO timeline?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com (Karthik Iyer)
To: Sara Li <sara@edgecart.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-19T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity — pricing bands and billing corridor

Sara,

Attached is a pricing workbook (proposed-pricing.xlsx) with two paths: Standard Uplift and Elastic Ladder (step-up triggers included). Summary below:
- Baseline commit: 25M tokens/month @ $0.00105/token (15% off list)
- Burst pocket: 10M tokens/month @ $0.0019/token (non-committed)
- Overage outside burst: $0.0025/token
- Early step-up incentive: if EdgeCart triggers the 3-month step-up, we lock current rates for the remainder of the term

Billing corridor notes:
- Prorated activation on signing date
- 30-day net for invoices; procurement charge rules accepted
- We can include a 60-day soft graceband to ease the first month of uplift (one-time credit applied retrospectively)

Kimberly — can you confirm DocuSign and legal placeholders so we can surface redlines early?

Karthik
Director, Commercial Operations
From: Sara Li <sara@edgecart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Mike Hall <mike.hall@edgecart.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity — pricing bands and billing corridor

Jonas / Karthik — this all looks workable. Two asks from procurement before we proceed:
1) Can you extend the soft graceband to 90 days for the first billing cycle? That helps us align PO timing with marketing spend.
2) We need the MAP to include a short acceptance criteria section for throughput & latency so our SREs can sign off.

We're targeting an exec sign-off next Tuesday if procurement can confirm PO timing. Mike — looping you to confirm payment cadence and PO lead time.

Thanks,
Sara
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com (Jonas Weber)
To: Sara Li <sara@edgecart.com>, Mike Hall <mike.hall@edgecart.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API capacity — pricing bands and billing corridor

Sara / Mike — happy to accommodate both asks.

Confirmed updates:
- Graceband extended to 90 days for the first uplift month. We'll apply a one-time billing credit if activation/PO timings cause a mismatch.
- MAP updated with acceptance criteria for throughput (sustained 95th pct <= 260ms) and a small sampling test plan for your SREs. See link: https://redwood.app/s/edgecart-maps/EDGE-2026-0918

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send the updated MAP + pricing into DocuSign by end of day. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC123
2) Once signed and PO received, we activate the uplift and schedule a 1-hour onboarding with our provisioning team to map routes and latency dashboards.

Deal ID EDGE-2026-0918. Please confirm the signers and Mike if there's a PO cutoff we should target.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
